flags.why: 'Chớ có ngộ nhận' warns against misunderstanding, whereas 'Make no mistake' normally asserts certainty.
The example uses 'chong mắt' to mean keeping one's eyes open and staring, already covered by sense 2, rather than a separate meaning 'to focus on' ([VDict](https://vdict.com/chong,3,0,0.html)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 3 and merge its example into sense 2.
